summary: Each rank owns a contiguous rebased CSR slice. On every requested timed iteration the runtime GPU branch allocates, transfers, launches full-row SpMV, retrieves and frees its buffers; without a GPU the OpenMP worker dynamically covers the entire local row range. Both actual paths retain every CSR multiply/accumulate and output store.
